exposure: Intention to give birth in a freestanding primary level midwife-led maternity unit (PMU)
intention to give birth in a freestanding primary level midwife-led maternity unit (PMU)
Intention to give birth in PMU vs TMH
Intention to give birth at a tertiary level obstetric-led maternity hospital (TMH)
intention to give birth in a tertiary level obstetric-led maternity hospital (TMH)
cohort: 407 women who intended to give birth in a PMU and 285 women who intended to give birth at the TMH in Canterbury, New Zealand, in 2010-2011.
finding: Women who planned a PMU birth had significantly higher rates of spontaneous vaginal birth and lower rates of instrumental assisted vaginal birth, with no differences in neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Women who planned a PMU birth had significantly higher rates of spontaneous vaginal birth and lower rates of instrumental assisted vaginal birth.
